sections.heading: Reliable Dirt & Gravel Delivery for Any Project
sections.body: Bellhouse Excavating provides bulk aggregate delivery for construction, driveways, drainage projects, landscaping, and site preparation. Whether the job needs gravel base, topsoil, sand, or fill, delivery is planned around access, material type, quantity, and where the load can be placed safely.
bullets: Bulk delivery of gravel, topsoil, sand, and fill
Tri-axle trucks for efficient material hauling
Clean dumping with practical placement on site
Useful for homeowners, builders, farms, and contractors

sections.heading: When Bellhouse Aggregate Delivery Fits the Job
sections.subheading: Best fit when material delivery needs to support actual site work, not just arrive at the curb.

cards.title: Driveways, lanes, and parking areas
cards.body: A practical fit when a driveway, farm lane, parking area, or pad needs base material brought in for grading, compaction, or surface repair.
cards.outcome: Gets material to the site in a way that supports the grading or base-prep work instead of slowing it down.

cards.title: Drainage, backfill, and site prep
cards.body: Useful when stone, sand, fill, or granular material needs to arrive as part of drainage work, backfill, pad prep, or rough grading.
cards.outcome: Keeps delivered material tied to the work area, access conditions, and next phase of construction.

cards.title: Contractor-led material movement
cards.body: A strong fit for builders and contractors who need truck timing, aggregate delivery, excavation, or grading support coordinated around an active job schedule.
cards.outcome: Helps avoid gaps between ordered material, truck availability, and crews waiting on the next load.

sections.heading: What Proper Delivery Planning Helps Prevent
sections.subheading: Bulk material delivery goes smoother when quantity, access, and placement are clear before the truck is on site.

items.problem: The wrong material can create drainage, compaction, or finish problems once the work starts.
items.solution: Bellhouse confirms the material type and intended use before delivery so the load fits the project.

items.problem: Poor dump placement can leave material blocking access or too far from the work area.
items.solution: Truck access and dump location are reviewed so the material lands where it can be used safely and efficiently.

items.problem: Jobs can lose time when aggregate delivery is separated from excavation, grading, or site prep timing.
items.solution: Bellhouse can coordinate delivery with trucking, grading, excavation, and contractor-led site schedules.

items.question: What materials do you deliver?
items.answer: Bellhouse can deliver gravel, sand, topsoil, fill, and other aggregates depending on the project and material availability.

items.question: Is there a minimum order?
items.answer: Most deliveries require at least one full dump truck load. If you are unsure about quantity, Bellhouse can review the material, location, and rough dimensions before scheduling.

items.question: Can you dump material exactly where I need it?
items.answer: We place material where truck access, overhead clearance, ground conditions, and safety allow. The best dump location is confirmed before delivery whenever possible.

items.question: Can delivery be coordinated with grading or excavation work?
items.answer: Yes. Bellhouse can coordinate material delivery with driveway prep, grading, drainage, excavation, or contractor-led site work when those scopes are part of the job.

sections.heading: Need Aggregates Delivered?
sections.body: Send the material type, delivery location, rough quantity, and timing and Bellhouse can review the next step.
